name: inverted row between chairs
description: A bodyweight row under a sturdy support between two chairs for the upper back and arms.
instructions: Set a sturdy bar or table edge between two stable chairs and lie under it.
Grip the support with straight arms and your body in a plank line.
Pull your chest toward the support.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the top.
Lower slowly until your arms are straight.
Keep your hips up the whole time.
